manifest.title: GlitchTip
manifest.author: Darkhorse
manifest.description:
GlitchTip collects application errors, uptime checks, and logs. Send events with any Sentry-compatible SDK.

This unofficial package uses Cloudron PostgreSQL, Redis, outbound mail, and disk for uploads. Sign-in can stay inside GlitchTip, or use Cloudron OpenID Connect.

https://glitchtip.com
manifest.changelog:
* GlitchTip 6.2.6
* PostgreSQL, Redis, outbound mail, and local uploads from Cloudron
* Optional Cloudron sign-in
manifest.postInstallMessage:
GlitchTip is ready at $CLOUDRON-APP-ORIGIN.

<sso>
Sign in with Cloudron. That first account is the administrator. Create an organization in the app. Later Cloudron accounts can sign in too.
</sso>

<nosso>
Open $CLOUDRON-APP-ORIGIN and create the first account. That person creates the organization. Public signup closes after that account.
</nosso>

Uploads are stored in /app/data/media.

first-admin-sso.message: Sign in with Cloudron. That first account is the administrator. Create an organization in the app.

first-admin-local.message: Create the first account on the sign-in page. That person creates the organization. Public signup closes after that account.
